sources.name: NCSCM CZMP 2019 — Maharashtra survey plots
sources.scope: Survey-plot outlines drawn on Maharashtra's Coastal Zone Management Plan 2019 maps, including city survey (CTS) and town-planning-scheme (TPS) plots in Greater Mumbai. Coverage follows mapped coastal planning areas and can omit inland neighbourhoods. Labels repeat within a village, so application references are derived from each outline and change when an outline changes.

sources.licenceNote: No reuse licence is stated on the CZMP portal or the ArcGIS service; the plan is published for public viewing.
caveats: Coastal-zone planning maps, not the land-records register: plot outlines are a geometry reference, not proof of current title or ownership.
The layer mixes CTS and TPS plots. VILLAGE + TYPE + label repeats for distinct polygons, so it is shown, never used as identity; OBJECTID is a transport field.

Application identity uses the source namespace plus canonical geometry SHA-256 at 1e-7-degree precision and a spatial locator, as for Nairobi. A changed outline gets a new reference; absence means that outline version was not returned.
The service answers browsers directly (CORS allows this site); no relay is used.
The plan dates from the CRZ Notification 2019; the survey date of the underlying plot maps is not stated.
